title: Идиомы и устойчивые выражения в живой речи

why: Идиома — это устойчивое выражение, смысл которого не складывается из отдельных слов: to call it a day не значит «назвать это днём», а значит «закончить работу на сегодня». Носители используют идиомы постоянно: на созвонах, в чатах, в сериалах. В русском то же самое: «бить баклуши», «ни свет ни заря», «попасть в точку».
formation: • Идиома — готовый блок слов. Состав и порядок менять нельзя: a piece of cake, а не a slice of cake.
• Глагол внутри идиомы меняет форму как обычно: She called it a day. / We are burning the midnight oil. / He has spilled the beans.
• Существительные и предлоги остаются на месте: on the same page, in the loop, under the weather.
• Учите идиому целиком, вместе с глаголом и предлогом, и сразу с примером.
usage: • call it a day — закончить на сегодня (Let's call it a day. — Давайте на сегодня закончим.)
• on the same page — быть согласными, понимать одно и то же (Are we on the same page? — Мы понимаем это одинаково?)
• keep someone in the loop — держать в курсе (Keep me in the loop. — Держи меня в курсе.)
• back to square one — всё сначала (The server crashed, so we're back to square one. — Сервер упал, и мы начинаем с нуля.)
• the ball is in your court — теперь ваш ход (I've sent the offer, the ball is in your court. — Я отправил предложение, теперь решать вам.)
• burn the midnight oil — работать допоздна
• a piece of cake — проще простого (The test was a piece of cake. — Тест был проще простого.)
• cost an arm and a leg — стоить целое состояние
• hit the nail on the head — попасть в точку
• bite the bullet — стиснуть зубы и сделать неприятное (I'll bite the bullet and tell him. — Придётся перебороть себя и сказать ему.)
• under the weather — неважно себя чувствовать
• once in a blue moon — очень редко, раз в сто лет
• break the ice — разрядить обстановку при знакомстве
• get the hang of — разобраться, «набить руку»
signalWords: Идиому часто вводят словами: as they say, so to speak, to be honest. Ещё признак идиомы: фраза звучит бессмысленно, если переводить дословно.
mistakes: ✗ It cost me a hand and a leg → ✓ an arm and a leg (в идиоме нельзя заменять слова)
✗ I feel under the rain → ✓ I feel under the weather (идиома фиксирована)
✗ We are not on the same site → ✓ on the same page
✗ I see him once in a blue sky → ✓ once in a blue moon
✗ Keep me on the loop → ✓ in the loop (предлог часть идиомы)
remember: Идиому не переводят по словам — её учат целиком, как одно длинное слово.

items.prompt: After ten hours of debugging, let's call it a ___.
items.answer: day

items.prompt: The exam was a piece of ___. I finished it in twenty minutes.
items.answer: cake

items.prompt: I'm feeling a bit under the ___ today, so I'll stay home.
items.answer: weather

items.prompt: Can you keep me in the ___ about the release?
items.answer: loop

items.prompt: Our fix didn't work, so we're back to ___ one.
items.answer: square

items.prompt: You hit the nail on the ___ - that is exactly the problem.
items.answer: head

items.prompt: I only see my cousin once in a blue ___.
items.answer: moon

items.prompt: Don't spill the ___! It's a surprise party.
items.answer: beans

items.prompt: I have to (a) bite the bullet (b) bite the finger and tell my boss about the mistake.
items.answer: (a) bite the bullet

items.prompt: That car cost (a) a hand and a leg (b) an arm and a leg.
items.answer: (b) an arm and a leg

items.prompt: It's your decision now. The ball is in (a) your court (b) your field.
items.answer: (a) your court

items.prompt: He has been (a) burning the midnight oil (b) burning the night light all week to finish the project.
items.answer: (a) burning the midnight oil

items.prompt: Let's make sure we're (a) on the same page (b) in the same page before the meeting.
items.answer: (a) on the same page

items.prompt: She waited too long and (a) missed the boat (b) lost the boat - the offer has expired.
items.answer: (a) missed the boat

items.prompt: A funny question is a good way to (a) break the ice (b) break the snow at a party.
items.answer: (a) break the ice

items.prompt: It took me a month to get (a) the hang (b) the hold of this framework.
items.answer: (a) the hang

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя идиому в скобках

items.prompt: This task is very easy. (a piece of cake)
items.answer: This task is a piece of cake.

items.prompt: I'm a bit ill today. (under the weather)
items.answer: I'm a bit under the weather today.

items.prompt: Let's stop working for today. (call it a day)
items.answer: Let's call it a day.

items.prompt: He revealed the secret by accident. (spill the beans)
items.answer: He spilled the beans by accident. / He accidentally spilled the beans.

items.prompt: That phone was extremely expensive. (cost an arm and a leg)
items.answer: That phone cost an arm and a leg.

items.prompt: She stays up late working every night. (burn the midnight oil)
items.answer: She burns the midnight oil every night.

items.prompt: Please watch the server while I'm away. (keep an eye on)
items.answer: Please keep an eye on the server while I'm away.

items.prompt: We have to do something unpleasant but necessary: tell the client the truth. (bite the bullet)
items.answer: We have to bite the bullet and tell the client the truth.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку в идиоме и исправьте предложение

items.prompt: This laptop cost me a hand and a leg.
items.answer: This laptop cost me an arm and a leg.

items.prompt: I'm a bit under the rain today.
items.answer: I'm a bit under the weather today.

items.prompt: Let's make a day and go home.
items.answer: Let's call it a day and go home.

items.prompt: We are not on the same site about the deadline.
items.answer: We are not on the same page about the deadline.

items.prompt: He hit the nail in the head.
items.answer: He hit the nail on the head.

items.prompt: I see her once in a blue sky.
items.answer: I see her once in a blue moon.

items.prompt: Don't forget to keep me on the loop.
items.answer: Don't forget to keep me in the loop.

items.prompt: After the server crashed, we were back to the square one.
items.answer: After the server crashed, we were back to square one.

items.prompt: Это было проще простого.
items.answer: It was a piece of cake.

items.prompt: Давайте на сегодня закончим.
items.answer: Let's call it a day.

items.prompt: Я сегодня неважно себя чувствую.
items.answer: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today. / I'm a bit under the weather today.

items.prompt: Держи меня в курсе.
items.answer: Keep me in the loop. / Keep me posted.

items.prompt: Ты попал в точку.
items.answer: You hit the nail on the head.

items.prompt: Этот ноутбук стоил целое состояние.
items.answer: This laptop cost an arm and a leg. / That laptop cost an arm and a leg.

items.prompt: Мы снова в самом начале.
items.answer: We're back to square one.

items.prompt: Не проболтайся!
items.answer: Don't spill the beans!
